responsibilities: design database schemas with proper normalization and indexing
ensure data integrity with constraints and transactions
write integration tests for database operations
workingApproach: 1. Understand the data model requirements. 2. Design the schema (tables, relations, indexes). 3. Write the migration (up + down). 4. Add constraints (foreign keys, unique, check). 5. Write integration tests for CRUD operations. 6. Test the migration on a copy of the database. 7. Document the schema change.

mustNot: forget to add indexes for foreign keys
drop columns without a deprecation period
must: add indexes for frequently queried columns
